title: Prompt gallery proof reel
summary: A typed request opens a vertical reel, a dense gallery and rolling count prove breadth, one example becomes a branching workflow, and a compact mark-and-URL close converts the proof into action.
use_when: a vertical developer-tool promo needs a fast proof of breadth
a product can show many visual examples before one focused workflow
a voice-over needs clear visual chapters without a music bed

look.type_style: bold grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking, 4-9 % of frame height; narrow serif and script accents

sfx.event: one gallery example fills the focus area

structure.shot: rounded prompt field types a 6-word request above a 4-word capability claim on a pale field
structure.camera: drift scale 1.00→1.04 with 56 px downward pan over 60 fr
structure.motion: prompt types over ~23 fr at human cadence, then submits; claim holds; both fade with easings.inExpo 7 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a 4-word contrast statement replaces the prompt, with its final word in a narrow display face
structure.camera: drift scale 1.04→1.00 with easings.inOutSine over 52 fr
structure.motion: words reveal in two lines over ~15 fr with easings.outExpo; final word settles last (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: dense wall of example cards rushes in behind a white panel whose three-digit inventory count rolls upward
structure.camera: drift scale 1.00→1.02 with 52 px upward pan over 38 fr
structure.motion: grid and panel land on springs.heavy ~24 fr; counter rolls for ~30 fr, easings.outExpo (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the inventory count resolves and gains a suffix while the example wall continues drifting
structure.camera: drift scale 1.00→1.01 with 20 px upward pan over 15 fr
structure.motion: suffix fades and rises 12 px on easings.outExpo 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a 4-word category line appears below the settled count while the gallery drifts behind it
structure.camera: drift scale 1.00→1.05 with 94 px upward pan over 75 fr
structure.motion: category words resolve left to right in ~15 fr with easings.outExpo, then hold (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a short growth qualifier appears under the count before the view selects one example
structure.camera: zoom-tier begins toward one gallery card over 8 fr
structure.motion: qualifier rises on easings.outExpo 8 fr as the chosen card starts springs.cameraIn (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: one dark example card enlarges while a 5-word workflow claim reveals one word at a time below
structure.camera: zoom-tier to the chosen card, then 961 px left pan with easings.inOutSine over 52 fr
structure.motion: card settles on springs.cameraIn ~15 fr; words reveal every 7-8 fr; card exits left on easings.inExpo 9 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: six round workflow tiles stack vertically as fine curved connectors grow from an off-screen source
structure.camera: drift scale 1.00→1.02 with 17 px right pan over 38 fr
structure.motion: connectors draw with easings.outQuint 20 fr; tiles land on springs.ui, stagger 4 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: black mark lockup appears above a 2-word imperative closing line on the pale field
structure.motion: mark and line blur-in on easings.outExpo 12 fr; script stroke settles on springs.snappy ~18 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the first closing line gives way to one benefit word while the mark remains fixed above
structure.motion: old line fades on easings.inExpo 7 fr; replacement blur-in uses easings.outExpo 10 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: small URL appears under the mark and benefit word, then the complete end card holds
structure.camera: drift scale 1.03→1.04 over 26 fr, visually still for the final ~0.6 s
structure.motion: URL fades in on easings.outExpo 8 fr, then all elements hold through the end (±0.25 s)

params.content.prompt: one request, no more than 6 words
params.content.hookClaim: short capability claim beneath the prompt
params.content.contrastLead: bridge statement before the display-face emphasis word
params.content.contrastAccent: one emphasized word on the second line
params.content.workflowWords: 5 words revealed one at a time around the focused example
params.content.workflowLabel: label under the six-tile branch map
params.content.url: short destination shown on the final hold; defaults to brand.url
params.fps: composition fps; default 30 and all timing scales with it
params.timing.duration: duration in frames at 30 fps; default 424

notes: One hard cut at 3.73 s; no detected music beats, so cut_on_beat is false (0/1). All sub-0.25 s entrance durations and spring choices are sheet-resolution measurements; overshoot is not measurable. SFX are planned by the glue rule, not measured. GalleryWall and BranchMap are local recipe components and use only brand tokens and generated abstract card art.
